metadata.Name: JaLeCoN
metadata.Description: JaLeCoN is a dataset for Japanese Lexical Complexity Prediction (LCP) for non-native readers. It provides separate complexity scores for Chinese/Korean annotators and others to address the readers' L1-specific needs. The dataset includes complexity scores for single words as well as multi-word expressions (MWEs) and is sourced from news articles and government press conference transcripts.
Provider: Nara Institute of Science and Technology
metadata.Paper Title: Japanese Lexical Complexity for Non-Native Readers: A New Dataset
metadata.Venue Title: Proceedings of the 2023 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing
Affiliations: Nara Institute of Science and Technology
metadata.Abstract: Japanese language that could affect lexical complexity, and their effects have yet to be studied. Lexical complexity prediction (LCP) is the task of predicting the complexity of words in a text on a continuous scale. It plays a vital role in simplifying or annotating complex words to assist readers. To study lexical complexity in Japanese, we construct the first Japanese LCP dataset. Our dataset provides separate complexity scores for Chinese/Korean annotators and others to address the readers’ L1-specific needs. In the baseline experiment, we demonstrate the effectiveness of a BERT-based system for Japanese LCP.
